annotations.text:
The one real finding:

21 places in the app use the iOS system .secondary / .tertiary. Those greys are cool and neutral, and every caption sits slightly blue on warm paper.

That, more than the layout, is why it read unfinished.

Landing, cut to the bone: nineteen words of body copy instead of ninety.

The three explained points are gone — they were arguing before anyone had heard it work. What is left is the promise, one line of substance, and the price.

The waveform breathes; everything else rises once and stops.
